current_difficulty_reason: Standard positive-martingale convergence does not provide L1 convergence when the unrestricted second moment can diverge. The authors construct good-trajectory truncations and control intersecting Poisson replicas by stochastic comparisons and dimension-dependent multibody energy constraints. The resulting summable simplex bounds make the truncation error uniformly small and close uniform integrability in every printed dimension case.
